visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blonde woman wearing a black coat and a beige scarf stands inside a brightly lit toy store. She points at a display of plush animals while talking. The background is filled with various colorful toys, clocks, and Japanese signage. (2) The scene shifts to the woman walking through a hallway, now wearing a patterned beanie and a backpack. She appears visibly upset, covering her eyes and nose with her hand as if crying, though it seems exaggerated for the camera. (3) The woman is back in the store, her expression changing to one of immense joy and surprise as she holds a large brown plush insect. A hand enters the frame, interacting with her and the toy. (4) A close-up shot shows a store clerk behind a counter, wearing a mask, carefully placing the large plush toy into a white shopping bag labeled 'VARIETY'. Clocks and character merchandise are visible on the shelves behind. (5) The final sequence shows the woman outdoors at night under bright artificial lights. She is walking while hugging the bagged plush toy tightly, laughing and looking up at the camera with a wide, happy smile.
